ownership.quote: Building infrastructure for secured agentic computing ... As a small team, our purpose is to build tools for the agentic future focused on federation, isolation, and trust. ... Our Portfolio [microsandbox, tool.store]

stage.note: No press release, Crunchbase/Tracxn profile (blocked by Cloudflare, 403), or YC listing (microsandbox / super-rad-company / superrad all 404 on ycombinator.com/companies/<slug>) surfaced any funding announcement. The maker, Super Rad Company (GitHub org superradcompany, formerly zerocore-ai; founders include Stephen Akinyemi 'appcypher' and 'toksdotdev'), describes itself only as 'a small team' with microsandbox and tool.store as its two portfolio products; no investors, round, or accelerator batch are mentioned anywhere on its site, GitHub org, or the 186-comment HN launch thread (May 2025, 402 points). Cannot distinguish bootstrapped from pre-seed/stealth without a source, so left unknown rather than guessed.

employees.source: https://superrad.company describes itself as 'a small team'; GitHub org superradcompany has ~70 followers and lists at least 2 named members (appcypher, toksdotdev) but no public headcount.

note: microsandbox is an Apache-2.0 open-source microVM sandbox runtime (libkrun-based) made by Super Rad Company, a small independent startup (formerly operating as the GitHub org zerocore-ai, now superradcompany) whose only other public product is tool.store. No funding round, investor, accelerator, or revenue figure could be confirmed within the research window; the managed cloud offering is still an invite-only private beta. Buyers should treat this as an early-stage, thinly-resourced vendor until financial backing is disclosed.
